name: Wrenix the Wretched
summary: Beside his strange apparatus in Ratchet, Wrenix the Wretched helps crack tough locks. The goblin tinker offers tools to open secure caches.

sections.title: A Tinker in Ratchet
sections.body: Wrenix the Wretched works beside his machinery in Ratchet, the goblin port on the Barrens coast. As a tinker of the Steamwheedle Cartel, he knows mechanisms and contraptions, and how to bypass locks and salvage what lies beyond them. Rogues and scouts working the coast can turn to him for help.

sections.title: The Gizmotronic Apparatus
sections.body: Wrenix keeps his gizmotronic apparatus close at hand. He uses it and his mechanical skill to supply thieves' tools and lock-picking instruments. Those seeking to recover stolen Southsea pirate contraband along the Merchant Coast can put them to use.

faq.answer: Wrenix is a goblin tinker in Ratchet, in the Barrens. He works beside his gizmotronic apparatus and deals in contraptions and lock-picking tools.
Wrenix can be found beside his large mechanical device in Ratchet, the port town on the eastern coast of the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the gizmotronic apparatus next to him?
faq.answer: Wrenix's gizmotronic apparatus is a goblin-made machine for tinkering and diagnostic work. He uses it to craft specialized instruments such as precision thieves' tools.

faq.q: Why is he helping adventurers against the Southsea Freebooters?
faq.answer: Southsea pirates along the Barrens coast keep valuable plunder in locked lockboxes. Wrenix's mechanical tools help resourceful rogues open them, for mutual profit.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can get tools from Wrenix and practice bypassing Southsea pirate lockboxes.
Wrenix's gizmotronic apparatus shows Steamwheedle gadgetry at work: noisy, temperamental, and effective at precision work.
